rule-plan.text: Planning is free. Look, talk, wait, read the map. No dice and no time pass. You can go back and change a Planning pick. The feed shows a Planning option with a dashed edge.

rule-gate.text: Planning is free: look, talk, wait. You can go back. Execution is final. Dice and consequences, and no undo. A solid option is an Execution choice. Once you break the seal, the result stands.

rule-reveal.text: Black bars cover what the feed cannot see. A choice can lift a bar. Press R or tap the bar to read what is under it. Some bars never lift.

rule-4df.text: Roll four Fate dice. Each shows +1, 0 or -1. Add them, then add your stat. Beat the difficulty to succeed. Match it to tie: you succeed at a cost. Beat it by three or more for success with style, and gain a Fate point.

rule-stress.text: Stress boxes fill when you are hurt. Meat is the body. Nerves is the mind. Systems is your chrome. Fill a track and you are taken out. Each track has its own size.

rule-exposure.text: Exposure is how clearly the feed has you. Careless acts raise it. Tradecraft lowers it. It never stops you. It decides what file the Algorithm keeps, and who reads it.

rule-compel.text: A compel is the GM offering you a complication that fits your Trouble. Accept it and gain a Fate point. Refuse it and pay one. Here the Algorithm is the GM.

rule-fate.text: A Fate point buys one thing luck could not. You start with three. Style and compels earn them. Invoke an aspect to spend one. Spend it on a person, not a die.

lore-protocol.text: A dead drop passes a message without a meeting. Here the message is a coffee cup: where the handle points, whether a stirrer lies across the rim, and a timestamp photo as proof.

lore-blackout.text: The Blackout is the night the world forgot. Nobody in the Institute explains it. g0 says it will, once you prove you can follow protocol.

h-protocol.text: Protocol does not care who is in the room. Do it anyway.

h-early.text: You are early. So is Chen. One of you has a reason.

h-plan.text: Looking is free. Touching is not. Choose when to stop.

h-gate.text: From here, everything costs something. Even the coffee.

h-split.text: Two tasks, one attention. The arithmetic is not kind.

h-blind.text: Every room has a seat the cameras forgot. Use it, then forget it.

h-tie.text: Close. Close is a grade, not a compliment.

h-fail.text: Everyone fails the first live drop. Not everyone files the report.

h-fate.text: Fate is a favour you do yourself. Spend it where it counts.

h-end-clean.text: Quiet is a product. You made some today.

h-end-noticed.text: A name on the frame is a debt. It comes due.

h-end-logged.text: Tomorrow a person reads your file. Be a dull read.

h-end-debrief.text: Failure teaches. It also files a report.

h-end-burned.text: Lie low. Learn to lie better. Both are free.

h-end-aborted.text: Safe is a fine word. It ends conversations.

h-end-changed.text: A cappuccino. Bold. Nobody will remember it, which was the point.

a-open.text: Channel 1 shows one person at the door. The feed has not seen this person for 21 days. The feed does not know why.

a-cup.text: Channel 3 shows a cup with a stirrer across the rim. The feed does not know what this means.

a-chen.text: Subject 2 is Chen, M. Clearance is yellow. The feed holds 4,812 earlier frames of Subject 2. Confidence is 97 percent.

a-track.text: Channel 3 has two faces in frame. The feed knows one face. Subject 1 has no name in the file.

a-cones.text: The subject looks at the ceiling for four seconds. The feed logs the look. The feed does not log the reason.

a-rhythm.text: The subject looks at Subject 2 for eleven seconds. The feed logs the look. The feed does not log the reason.

a-counter.text: Channel 2 shows two people. One person watches a screen. The other person is Subject 1.

a-card.text: Student card read. Subject 1 is Ann Sho. Confidence is 91 percent. The feed files this visit under campus.

a-cash.text: Payment is 12 yen in cash. No card is read. Subject 1 has no name in the file.

a-badge.text: Badge B2C7 read. Subject 1 is Sable Harker, an AlgoCratic employee. The feed files this visit under her name.

a-dice.text: The feed rolls four dice when the result is not certain. The feed does not choose the result.

a-fail.text: Subject 1 stops with one hand at the pocket. Subject 2 looks up. The feed logs an anomaly.

a-tie.text: Subject 2 looks up for one second. Subject 1 takes the photo late. The feed logs a late glance.

a-success.text: The pass takes three seconds. Subject 2 looks down again. The feed logs no anomaly.

a-style.text: The pass takes three seconds. Subject 2 does not look up. The feed cannot see the photo.

a-blind.text: Subject 1 enters a seat that no channel covers. The feed logs a gap of nine seconds. The feed has no reason for the gap.

a-compel.text: The feed offers a complication. The clone model has logged a tremor in the subject's hand. Accept it and gain one Fate point. Refuse it and pay one.

a-invoke-chen.text: Subject 2 files a note about Subject 1. The note says exam stress. The feed reads the note.

a-invoke-loyal.text: Subject 1 matches Sable Harker. Sable Harker has a loyalty score of 7.2. The feed closes the anomaly.

a-phone.text: A phone vibrates once. The feed sees the screen. The feed cannot read the image on it.

a-abort.text: Subject 1 sits at the table of Subject 2. Both faces stay in frame for 20 minutes. Confidence is 99 percent.

a-change.text: Subject 1 sits with her back to Channel 3. A barista clears one cup in nine minutes. The feed logs no event.

a-end-clean.text: The file is closed. Exposure is low. The event field is empty.

a-end-noticed.text: The file is open. Exposure is medium. One note is on file, and no flag.

a-end-logged.text: The file is open. Exposure is high. A flag is set. A person reads the file in 24 hours.

a-end-debrief.text: The file records one failed event. The feed does not know who Subject 1 contacts.

a-end-burned.text: Subject 2 files no report about Subject 1. The feed notes the omission.

a-end-aborted.text: Subject 1 and Subject 2 share a table for 20 minutes. The feed logs a friendly contact. The feed logs no event.

a-end-changed.text: Subject 1 leaves at 07:12. The file has no event. The feed does not know what it missed.

g-observe.text: TIP: Looking is free. It costs no time and no dice. I have never regretted a look. I have regretted every rush. Pick the look that fits your plan: the cameras for a straight walk, Chen for a split.

g-pay.text: TIP: The coffee is a choice too. Cash names no one. A card names you. A badge names you loudly. The feed reads whatever the register reads. Cheap coffee, expensive file.

g-exposure.text: TIP: Exposure is the score the feed keeps on your face. Low is quiet. High gets a human to read your file. It never stops you. It changes what is waiting at the end. Watch the bar.

g-4df.text: TIP: Code +3 against 2 fails about one roll in five and ties about one in five. The rest succeed. Do not call that safe. Call it good odds with bad luck waiting.

g-split.text: WARNING: Splitting your attention is harder: difficulty 3, not 2. Code +3 now fails about two rolls in five. Time it to her stylus and it drops back to 2. Plan first.

g-chen.text: BOSS: MANAGER CHEN. Weak to: facts. Strong against: lies, nerves and small talk. She marks everything in red. Do not out-talk her. Out-prepare her. Note: she is early today. That is her first move.

g-fate.text: TIP: Spend Fate on people, not dice. A point on a roll is a point you did not need. A point on Chen buys you the next scene. Earn points by style, or by saying yes to a compel. Do both.

g-abort.text: ENDING NOTE: Aborting is safe, and it closes the story. g0 does not call again. You may go back and take the risk. I did. Twice. The stirrer was still there.

g-change.text: ENDING NOTE: Changing the order is the polite way to fail. Nobody is hurt. Nothing is learned. The barista clears the cup. Chen never knew you were there.
